verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole portrait poster into a narrow strip in the middle of the wide banner. That leaves huge empty white areas on both sides, and the body copy and the March 21 date become too small to read; it is a letterbox, not a resize. B is unusable: the headline and the date are white or cream on the white canvas, so they are invisible or half-invisible, and the copy and the 'Joint celebration' line are cut off at the edges of the narrow forest panel. The divider rules also float loose at the bottom.
